Why your site is slow & what to do

Posted on March 1, 2026 by Sam

Most pages ship far more CSS than they use. The browser has to download, parse and match every rule, even the unused ones. Use coverage in DevTools to see it.

Three quick wins

  1. Remove unused CSS.
  2. Set width and height on images.
  3. Lazy-load everything below the fold.

Performance is a feature.

img { max-width: 100%;
      height: auto; }

MetricBeforeAfter
LCP3.1 s1.2 s
